purpose: Does ordering with the frozen AI purchasing-protection selections, repeated over many review cycles, reduce lost sales enough to pay for the extra stock it holds, and does it beat the seller's own safety stock?

governance.amendment_F1: decision protection stays research-only; no result here authorises promotion (promotion_authorised false)
governance.pass_means: an implementation review of OPTIONAL, seller-approved advice for that segment and level only
governance.clearance: owner's direct instruction of 2026-10-14 to finish the module (the architect's clearance was still pending; the owner's instruction takes precedence). The development rehearsal selected nothing and changed no gate.
governance.no_new_candidates: the candidates are the frozen A2 selections of protocol v1 (sha 8c385172f651bef23b40cbb75a8508af8d3ffbc62c54781914406c3472a445af); nothing is selected or tuned here

comparators.D0: Stage 2 quantity on the point forecast (A1), safety stock 0
comparators.seller_rule: Stage 2 quantity with a seller-set safety stock of k days of average daily sales over the 28 days before the replay, fixed at the start, k in [2, 4, 7, 10, 14]

replay.review_forecasts: frozen release served at every review day on history up to that day
replay.lost_sales: unmet demand is lost (A3); a lower bound where stock-outs are unknown
replay.starting_stock: kappa x forecast for the first L + 1 + R days (A1; T28/28 rate when T28 < T7), rounded
replay.inconsistent_forecast: T28 < T7: no policy orders at that review (the engine gives no quantity)
replay.paths: 100 analogue paths per series and review (own windows; pooled by category and segment below 6); D2c zeroes 25 December; seeded per series and review
replay.cell_rule: a cell's method is used at a review only when the product is in the cell's segment then; otherwise D0. The cell is evaluated on the series in its segment at the start of the replay.
replay.unit_value: M5 weekly sell price (cost is not in the data)

data.development: consumed 180 + development_extra 150 products x 10 stores, guarded loaders, days <= 2015-10-31
data.final: reservation nexus-stage3-seq-m5-v1: 150 never-read products x 10 stores (outputs/reservation_seq_m5.json)
data.excluded: series with fewer than 28 days of history at the replay start (reported, never replaced)

gates.G1: >= 30 series and >= 200 series x pair replays in the cell
gates.G2: lost units below D0, pooled over the five pairs at kappa 1; product-cluster and 28-day date-block 95% bootstrap intervals (B = 1000) of the reduction both above 0
gates.G3: net benefit = margin x value of avoided lost sales - holding rate / 365 x extra stock value-days > 0 at the primary assumptions; both 95% intervals above 0
gates.G4: at the candidate's stock-holding value the seller-rule curve S(0..14 days) (linear interpolation) loses at least as much sales value; a candidate holding more than S(14) fails
gates.G5: at kappa 0.5 and 1.5 the reduction and the primary net benefit stay above 0
gates.G6: >= 2000 sampled final-run decisions (D0 and a seller rule) recomputed by backend/lib/replenishment/engine.js equal the replay exactly
gates.all: a cell passes only if G1–G6 all hold

execution.rerun_protection: hash checks; preflight; O_CREAT|O_EXCL lock; non-empty output refused; aborted runs keep the lock
